history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person stands in front of a white scooter at night. They are wearing a white hoodie with a large grey star and the word "Clifton" written in a script font on the back, black shorts, and black slides. The person has a black baseball cap on and is adjusting the back of their hoodie. The scooter is parked on a paved surface, and behind it is a dark, outdoor area with a metal structure covered by a corrugated roof. There are some plants with green and yellow leaves hanging from wires in the background, and a black mesh fence. The lighting is dim and atmospheric, with some artificial light sources creating highlights on the scooter and casting shadows. The overall mood is casual and slightly moody, with a focus on the individual and their attire. The color palette is dominated by whites, blacks, greys, and the muted greens and yellows of the foliage.
